header.si_note: Generated by pipeline/flame_temperature/gaps.py, a script written with SI assistance (Claude Code, Anthropic). The humans chose the idea and the method.
header.scope: Scope: PSI's droplet tables only: FLEX (PSI-69) and CFI (PSI-39) per test, FLEX-2 (PSI-68) as a planned range. The ACME gas-flame tables were not checked. Droplet tests in microgravity only.
header.not_a_prediction: The distance says how far a condition is from the nearest real test. It is not a prediction of what a flame would do there.
header.region: 30 to 34% oxygen at about 0.7 atm (the grid's 0.7 atm step), per the challenge text ("likely 30% oxygen or more at 10.2 psi or less"); not a NASA spec
header.region_cells: every grid position with oxygen 0.30 to 0.34 and pressure 0.7 atm, one row per fuel, added gas and level (droplet size is not part of a cell)
header.distance: sqrt(sum over oxygen, carbon dioxide and helium mole fraction and pressure in atm of ((cell - test) / span)^2). Each span is the width of the bench's slider range on that axis, read from flex_grid.json, so 1.0 is as far as one whole slider. Fuel and droplet size are not part of it. 0 means a real test sits at exactly these gas conditions.
header.nearest_test_id: the closest real per-test row in FLEX (PSI-69) or CFI (PSI-39), any fuel; ties go to FLEX, then the lower test number
header.nearest_same_fuel_test_id: the closest FLEX test of the cell's fuel (CFI burned other fuels), with its distance in distance_same_fuel
header.ranking: distance, largest first; then distance_same_fuel, largest first
header.model_fails_here: true for helium cells; see model_fails_here in flex_grid.json's header

header.cfi_carbon_dioxide: CFI lists only oxygen, nitrogen and helium, so its carbon dioxide is 0
header.flex2: FLEX-2 (PSI-68) holds no per-test rows, only a planned range, so it gives no nearest test; it is used only for the notes

coverage.diluted_rule: carbon dioxide or helium above 0.01 mole fraction

header.headline: In PSI's per-test droplet tables (FLEX PSI-69, CFI PSI-39) no diluted test sits above 25% oxygen. FLEX-2 (PSI-68) lists helium mixtures up to 30% oxygen as its planned range, but PSI holds no per-test rows to say which flew. Carbon dioxide dilution above 25% oxygen appears in none of the three.

campaign.method: Design augmentation by greedy maximin distance (Johnson, Moore and Ylvisaker 1990): take the condition farthest from every real test, count it as flown, then take the condition farthest from the real tests and the earlier picks together, and repeat. Same distance and spans as the gap list. No model is used and nothing is predicted.
campaign.why: The ranked list scores each condition on its own, so its top rows are near-copies of one corner. Once the first of them is flown the others are no longer far from a test. The batch takes each earlier pick into account, so its tests spread over the region.
campaign.fuel: Fuel and droplet size are not part of the distance, so a pick is a gas condition. Which fuel to burn at it is left open.
campaign.not_a_prediction: The distance says how far a condition is from the nearest real test. It is not a prediction of what a flame would do there.
campaign.conditions: the distinct gas conditions of the rows below (fuel collapsed)
